title: Episode About the Expansion of the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: Weapons and precious goods were seized back from oppressors, and in many places fierce clashes broke out. (32)
The authorities became deeply hostile toward the Singhs, especially wherever households sheltered or fed them. (33)
Thus enmity sharpened between the Singhs and the established powers, and those who aided the Khalsa were themselves harassed. (34–35)
